about: Landmark (photo) rounds planned but not yet added, mostly to even out the regions: of the 164 landmarks, about 75 are in Europe and 12 in Africa. Each has an id, a label in the style of the existing ones, a region, a tolerance in km and, where it matters, a note on the photo.

skipped.Western Wall: next to the Dome of the Rock, so the same answer
skipped.Kaaba, Mecca: religiously sensitive as a photo to guess from
skipped.Itsukushima Shrine: 20 km from the Hiroshima Peace Memorial
skipped.Mount Fitz Roy: Patagonia already has Torres del Paine and Perito Moreno
skipped.Hassan II Mosque: Morocco already has Chefchaouen, and gets Marrakech and Aït Benhaddou
skipped.Rialto Bridge, Astronomical Clock, Littl: Venice, Prague and Copenhagen already have one each
